_note: REACHED VIA PROBE: HeadersScreen reads and writes ONE tRPC row
(siteDetail.settings.get / .update), so the probe answers that procedure and
lets the real screen run. Hosted in the board's own pane —
`.bd-set-pane-body`, which SettingsTab owns — at 824, which is 760 (the card)
plus its two 32 insets. Same host and same arithmetic as
s7-settings-general; the ten S7 screens share one pane rather than ten.
ALREADY CONFORMANT, and this recipe is what proves it: 56 properties across
four cards and four fields. The chassis moved on s7-settings-general
(638:2378) — cards, the 180 label column, uppercase 11px card titles, the
bg-app pane — and this screen inherited every bit of it through
settings/shared.tsx. Nothing visual changed here.
CODE CHANGED — AN ANCHOR DEFECT, not a visual one, and it was blocking the
measurement rather than showing up in it. `Field` derives its test id from
its LABEL, and this board names TWO fields 'Policy' (640:3109 under
X-FRAME-OPTIONS, 640:3117 under REFERRER-POLICY). Both rendered
`data-testid="set-field-policy"`, so the id resolved to two elements and the
Referrer-Policy field could not be addressed by any probe or test — a
selector that matches two things measures the first and reports success.
`Field` now takes an optional `anchor` stem (defaulting to the label, so the
other twelve screens are byte-identical) and HeadersScreen passes
`x-frame-policy` / `referrer-policy`. The on-screen copy is untouched: the
board says 'Policy' twice and it still says 'Policy' twice.
ALSO CHANGED, same file, same reason: `<Section title="">` — which Headers
and Localization both use for their trailing save row — rendered an EMPTY
<h3> (an unlabelled heading in the a11y tree) and derived `set-card-` /
`set-card-title-` from the empty string, a junk anchor two screens both
claimed. Section now omits the heading and both ids when the title is empty.
NOT JOINED, and why:
640:3125 Field · Enable HSTS — the board draws a TOGGLE above Max age;
live folds 'off' into the Max age select's own null preset, so there is no
second control to measure. That is a control-count difference, not drift in
a control that exists, and adding a toggle whose only job is to set the
select to null is a product call, not a conformance one. Reported.
gutters, radius 8 on a --flowbite/gray/300 edge. Live is
SETTINGS_SELECT_THEME in shared.tsx: 5px radius, --bk-gray-200, 7/9
padding. This is a SHARED primitive behind all thirteen S7 screens and the
board's reading is NOT isolated — 638:2702 on the General board draws the
identical box, so four instances across two boards agree and nothing
contradicts them. FLAGGED FOR THE ORCHESTRATOR as a family-wide move worth
making deliberately, not taken off one screen mid-pass.
FOUND, NOT FIXED: live draws a fifth card, PERMISSIONS-POLICY, that this
board does not — a header the product supports and the board never got.
And the screen opens with a 'Not yet enforced' banner saying the values save
but are never applied to HTTP responses; the board draws no such banner and
no such caveat, so the board describes a screen that works and the product
ships one that stores. That is the more important of the two.
